prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: 4:3 website cinematic key frame
Input images: Image 1 is a composition-and-action reference only; retain its framing, curled pose, plush hug, bedroom layout, and night window but do not retain its rendering, textures, color grading, or character design. Image 2 is the sole authoritative reference for visual style, character identity, facial design, line quality, materials, and color palette.
Primary request: completely repaint the scene from scratch as a clean Japanese TV-anime cel key frame. Keep Image 1's action: the girl sits curled safely on the pink bed, hugs the gray cat plush against her chest with both arms, and gives the visitor a small warm shy smile.
Subject: exactly the same cute young teen girl as Image 2: rounded youthful face, large clear layered blue eyes, tiny mouth, subtle blush, cold silver-white long hair, pink bows, petite light-chibi proportions. Preserve Image 1's blue-and-white gingham long-sleeve pajamas and striped fluffy socks.
Scene/backdrop: preserve Image 1's bedroom geometry, lamp, shelf, curtains, closed window, moon, pillows, and book. Redraw all interior materials with Image 2's airy palette: pale honey-blond wood, cream, strawberry milk pink, soft mint, and clear navy-blue outside the window.
Style/medium: bright modern Japanese TV animation cel art; thin stable clean linework; large perfectly flat textureless color fills; at most two simple hard-edged shadow levels; restrained clean highlights; crisp hair silhouette; uncluttered production key-frame finish.
Lighting/mood: clear readable night scene, gently bright interior, clean peach bedside light and cool moonlight, sleepy and safe; no muddy purple-brown cast or crushed shadows.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1's exact 4:3 camera, character scale, curled body pose, plush position, bed geometry, moon placement, and open sightline. The window frame stays completely behind the character and does not cross her face or body.
Constraints: Image 2 alone controls identity, style, palette, skin clarity, and cold-white hair. Image 1 controls only composition, action, and pajamas. Exactly one character, two arms, two hands, two legs; hands wrap naturally around the plush. All ages appropriate. No readable text, signature, logo, or watermark.
Avoid: foreground window bars, duplicate moon, oil painting, watercolor, gouache, painterly brushwork, canvas texture, paper grain, fabric grain, wood grain microtexture, film grain, noise, speckles, stains, dirty color, brown varnish, glossy dark wood, fog, haze, bloom, soft focus, airbrush gradients, granular shadows, micro-detail accumulation, mature proportions, sexualization, malformed hands, text, watermark.
pipeline: 内置 ImageGen 逐图清晰化；Pillow Lanczos 纯缩放响应式导出
resizeMethod: Lanczos；不添加锐化、纹理、降噪或调色滤镜
